# 1 Enoch Chapter 27 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**1** Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: "This accursed valley is for those who are accursed forever; here shall all the accursed be gathered — those who utter with their lips unseemly words against the Lord and speak hard things about his glory. Here they shall be gathered, and here shall be their place of judgment.

**2** "And in the last days there shall be upon them the spectacle of righteous judgment in the presence of the righteous forever: here shall the merciful bless the Lord of glory, the Eternal King.

**3** "And in the days of judgment over the former, they shall bless him for the mercy with which he has assigned them their lot."

**4** Then I blessed the Lord of Glory and proclaimed his glory and praised him gloriously.

**5** And from there I went toward the east, into the midst of the mountain range of the desert; and I saw a wilderness that was solitary, full of trees and plants.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Ge'ez text. Chapter 27 provides Uriel's interpretation: the accursed valley is the place of eternal judgment for blasphemers — the Gehenna tradition. The righteous will witness this final judgment (vv. 2-3). Verse 5 begins the transition to the second cosmic journey (chs. 28-36): eastward into the desert mountain range.*
